key_insight: Self-evolving agents can improve overall performance without updating model weights, but greater adaptability often comes at the cost of retaining earlier capabilities.
engineering_relevance: For computational engineering assistants, prompt, memory, or skill updates should be checked for regressions before deployment across changing tools and workflows.
method: Keep model weights frozen while adapting prompts, memory, or skills from task feedback.
Evaluate ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness on four drifting task streams.
Compare adaptation gains with retention and interference across tasks.
evidence_signal: Across four streams built from BIRD, BFCL, and ScienceWorld, self-evolution improved aggregate performance on most streams, but higher plasticity consistently reduced stability.
watch_item: The abstract reports no solid-mechanics benchmark; shared edits and conflicting memory retrieval warrant domain-specific regression testing.
